reason: The company is proceeding with a privatization proposal via a scheme of arrangement, which typically involves a premium to the prevailing market price to secure shareholder approval.
why_now: An update on the timeline for the dispatch of the scheme document was released on August 28, 2026, moving the deal closer to completion.
